A small shop outside Chicago

WindyCityWares is based in Schaumburg, Illinois, in the Chicago suburbs. We make memorial urns that feel personal rather than clinical: aluminum urns finished in high-gloss enamel and printed with a scene that says something about the life they hold.

Most designs come as a full-size urn, as small keepsakes, or as a set of both, so a family can share a loved one’s ashes and keep them close.
